description: A generous body mist with neroli, a little honeyed flower and a soft musk, at a concentration low enough to use after a shower without thinking about it. It lasts about two hours on skin and much longer on a cotton T-shirt. The bottle is big because it is not meant to be rationed.
details: Lasts longer on fabric than on skin

name: Fluffy Powder Brush
short: A domed fibre brush that puts powder on and takes the excess away.
description: A soft domed brush with taklon fibres cut at two lengths, so it picks up a small amount of powder and distributes it without a patch of matte appearing on the cheek. The handle is weighted aluminium, short enough to control. It sheds nothing after forty washes, which is the actual test.
details: Domed cut for a soft, diffused line

name: Precision Concealer Brush
short: A small flat brush for under the eyes and around the nose.
description: A densely packed, slightly rounded concealer brush that presses product into the inner corner and along the nose without dragging the thin skin there. The ferrule is crimped so the bristles will not splay with daily use. It works equally well for correcting a single mark.
details: Small enough for the inner corner

name: Angled Brow Brush
short: A stiff, cut-angle brush that draws a line and then softens it.
description: A firm, sharply angled brush with enough spring to lay pomade along a clean bottom edge, then flick the top soft with the same stroke. The fibres are synthetic and slightly coarse, which is what holds a pomade line. Short handle, so it stays accurate at the tail.
details: Firm cut angle for a crisp edge
Slightly coarse synthetic fibre holds pomade
Use with the flat side, not the tip

name: Silicone Cleansing Pad
short: A soft silicone pad that takes sunscreen off without a scrub.
description: A flexible silicone pad with fine nubs that work cleanser into the pores by vibration and slip rather than abrasion, then rinses clean in one shake. It dries in seconds and never grows anything unpleasant in a bathroom corner. Use it with your existing cleanser, on damp skin, for a minute.
details: No bacteria harbouring like a cloth
Use with any gel or cream cleanser

name: Sonic Facial Cleansing Brush
short: A slow sonic brush with three settings and a charge that lasts a month.
description: A compact sonic cleansing brush with soft silicone touchpoints and three gentle speeds, sized to reach the jawline and the sides of the nose where hands habitually miss. It is waterproof, charges over USB-C and turns itself off after a minute. Use it at night only if your skin is reactive.
details: Waterproof, USB-C, one month per charge
Nightly use only on sensitive skin

name: Cushion Makeup Sponge, Two Pack
short: Two non-absorbent sponges that bounce foundation in rather than drink it.
description: A pair of high-density sponges with a closed cell structure, so they take a fraction of the foundation a ordinary sponge does and give a smooth airbrushed surface when you bounce rather than drag. Use them slightly damp for a dewy finish and dry for more coverage. The flat edge is for under the eye.
details: Damp for dewy, dry for coverage
Two sponges, replace every three months

name: Microfiber Makeup Remover Cloth
short: A plain cloth and warm water, which is genuinely enough.
description: A dense microfiber cloth that lifts long-wear makeup, including mascara, with warm water alone, in about ninety seconds of patient pressing and short strokes. It comes with a second, smaller cloth for the eyes and a mesh wash bag. Wash them without fabric softener or they stop working.
details: Works with warm water alone, no product
Second small cloth for the eyes
Removes waterproof mascara in ninety seconds

name: Quartz Facial Roller
short: A cool stone roller for the morning face and the evening serum.
description: A single-piece quartz roller with a smaller end for the under-eye and a larger one for the cheeks, used to move a serum in and take the sleepy puffiness down. Keep it cool, always press outward and upward, and clean the stone between uses. It will not sculpt anything, but it feels extraordinary.
details: One solid piece, no glued joints
Wipe with soap and water after use

name: Stainless Steel Gua Sha
short: A non-porous steel tool you can actually keep clean.
description: A solid stainless tool with three edges, cut for the jawline, the cheekbone and the brow, which glides over facial oil without stretching the skin. Unlike stone it will not chip in a bathroom shelf and it can be washed properly after every use. Four minutes a day, and the morning face looks less puffy.
details: Three contoured edges for jaw, cheek and brow
Glides over facial oil, never on dry skin

specs.v: Soap and water after each use

name: Satin-Lined Hair Claw
short: A large clip with a satin interior so the updo does not crease.
description: A heavyweight acetate claw lined with satin on the inner teeth, which is what stops the dent-and-frizz pattern a bare plastic clip leaves at the back of the head. It holds thick hair all day without loosening. Also the best tool for taking a braid out without a fight.

name: Silk Sleep Bonnet
short: A double-layer silk cap that keeps a style intact to the pillow.
description: A double-layer mulberry silk bonnet with a wide, flat elastic band at the forehead, so a blow-dry or a set of curls survives the night without moving. It does not squeeze the head, and the satin lining against the hair is the point. Machine wash cold in a bag and hang to dry.
details: Flat elastic band, no temple pressure
Machine wash cold in a mesh bag

name: Microfiber Waffle Hair Towel
short: A waffle-weave towel that cuts twenty minutes out of blow-drying.
description: A fast-absorbing microfiber towel in a waffle weave, which pulls water out of the hair far quicker than terry does and leaves far less frizz because there is nothing to rub with. Twist, do not rub, and leave it on while you do the rest of the routine. It dries overnight on a rail.
details: Twist and clamp instead of rubbing
Reduces the frizz caused by rubbing

name: Mulberry Silk Pillowcase
short: A pillowcase with a hidden zip and enough silk to fold under.
description: A 22 momme mulberry silk case with an envelope fold long enough to stay put on a deep mattress, which is where the friction on hair and the crease on the cheek get solved. It is not a skincare product and does not claim to be; it is simply less abrasive than cotton at three in the morning. Machine wash cold, no bleach.
details: Machine wash cold in a bag

name: Bamboo Detangling Comb
short: A wide-tooth bamboo comb with rounded tips for wet hair.
description: A single-piece bamboo comb with widely spaced, hand-rounded teeth that goes through wet, conditioned hair from the ends upward without snapping anything. Bamboo is light, it does not build static, and it will not warp if you hang it up rather than leave it in the shower. It takes a belt of product off, too.
details: Start at the ends, work upward
Single piece, will not snap at the spine
Hang to dry, do not leave wet

name: Stainless Slant Tweezers
short: Japanese steel, hand-aligned tips, and a grip that stops the slipping.
description: A pair of slant-tip tweezers cut from hardened Japanese stainless and aligned by hand so the two edges meet along their full length, which is the difference between pulling a hair and snapping it. The knurl on the barrel keeps them steady with damp fingers. They stay sharp for years and can be sent back for realigning.
details: Tips aligned by hand, edge to edge
Knurled barrel, no slipping with wet hands
Pulls rather than snaps the hair
Send back for realignment, no charge

name: Professional Lash Curler
short: A sprung steel curler with a replaceable pad that does not pinch.
description: A well-sprung curler with a genuinely curved frame suited to flatter eye shapes, and a silicone pad that gives at exactly the right pressure. Three pulses at the root, mid-length and tip will hold a curl all day on straight lashes. The pads and the whole mechanism are replaceable, so it is the last one you buy.
details: Curved frame for flatter eye shapes

name: Illuminated Travel Mirror
short: A fold-flat mirror with true daylight and a charge you forget about.
description: A slim, fold-flat mirror with LEDs tuned to daylight at 5000 K and a dimmer that goes bright enough for eyeliner in a dark hotel bathroom. It runs about forty minutes on a charge, folds to a centimetre thick and stands on its own base. The glass version of this product would not survive a bag; this one is acrylic.
details: About forty minutes per USB-C charge

name: Brush Roll Organiser
short: A waxed cotton roll with elastic loops and a real place for eight tools.
description: A roll-up organiser in water-resistant waxed cotton with elastic sockets sized for a powder brush, three eye brushes, a concealer brush, tweezers, a curler and a liner pencil. It unrolls flat on a hotel counter, which is the only way to find the right one at speed. The ends fold over and stay closed with a brass stud.
details: Nine elastic sockets plus two flat pockets

name: Silicone Travel Bottle Set
short: Five squeezable bottles with wide tops that do not leak in a bag.
description: A set of five soft silicone bottles with wide, flip-open tops and a genuine seal, sized to the 100 ml cabin limit and easier to empty than the stiff plastic ones. The flat sides mean they do not roll around inside a toiletry bag. Clean with warm soapy water and dry with the caps off.
details: Wide flip-top, real seal, no leaks
Squeezes fully, so you get the last of it
Flat sides, no rolling in the bag

name: Pumice and Foot File Duo
short: One natural stone and one stainless file, for the end of a long day.
description: A pair of foot tools: a genuine volcanic pumice stone for general roughness and a fine stainless file with two grits for the edge of the heel. Both have long handles so you are not contorted over a basin, and both dry quickly on a hook. Work on dry skin only, and never past the point of comfort.
details: Stainless file with coarse and fine grit
Dry on a hook between uses

specs.v: Coarse and fine on the file
